calculations. If Beijing struggles to absorb the shock, it may invite further

weaknesses. Avoiding this outcome will require hastening the diversification
of supply routes and expanding domestic production wherever possible.

global partnerships will be essential. The coming months could test not only
China’s energy resilience but also the credibility of its wider geopolitical
ambitions.
